raw.query: WITH current_grid AS (SELECT window_name, COUNT(*) AS current_config_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE superseded_by IS NULL) AS not_superseded_rows FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = TRUE AND experiment = 'grid' GROUP BY window_name) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS denominator_windows, gwr.n_windows, w.window_name, cg.current_config_rows, cg.not_superseded_rows, w.span_h, w.c_star_as_ingested, w.c_star_effective, w.is_superseded, w.tp_star, w.n_star, w.gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective, w.gpu_hours_h100, cf.cheapest_feasible_c, cf.cheapest_feasible_llm_gpus, s.static_encoder_workers_effective, s.binding_window_effective FROM provenance.grid_window_effective AS w JOIN current_grid AS cg USING (window_name) JOIN provenance.grid_run_summary_effective AS gwr ON gwr.grid_run_id = w.grid_run_id JOIN provenance.v_grid_cheapest_feasible AS cf ON cf.grid_run_id = w.grid_run_id AND cf.window_name = w.window_name CROSS JOIN provenance.v_grid_static_effective AS s ORDER BY w.window_name
